name: SigilVault
tagline: Authentication infrastructure for the resale floor.
positioning: SigilVault gives independent resale boutiques the authentication, provenance, and certificate workflows that used to require an in-house expert.

hero.h1: Every item verified before it hits your shelf.
hero.sub: SigilVault turns handbag, watch, and sneaker authentication into a documented, defensible workflow — so your two-person boutique moves with the confidence of a full-time authentication team.

features.title: Guided authentication checks
features.description: Step-by-step inspection flows for 900+ brands and references. Capture serials, stitching, hardware, and hologram evidence without guessing what to photograph.

features.title: Provenance you can defend
features.description: Chain-of-custody records tie every unit to its intake, inspector, and evidence set — the paper trail you need when a marketplace or buyer disputes a sale.

features.title: Branded certificates
features.description: Issue tamper-evident digital and printable certificates of authenticity under your own boutique name in under a minute per item.

features.title: Chargeback protection
features.description: Export a complete evidence dossier for any order, formatted for the dispute portals of major payment and resale platforms.

features.title: Intake in seconds
features.description: Scan a serial or snap a photo and SigilVault pre-fills the reference, category, and required checks so consignment intake never bottlenecks the counter.

features.title: Team accountability
features.description: See who authenticated what, review flagged units, and require a second signoff on high-value pieces across every seat on your floor.

testimonials.quote: We were turning down consignment because nobody on staff could vouch for it. SigilVault let two of us authenticate confidently, and our return rate on handbags dropped to almost nothing.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The chargeback dossier alone paid for the subscription. I won three disputes last quarter that I would have eaten silently a year ago.
testimonials.name: Declan Ophus

testimonials.quote: Onboarding a new floor associate used to take months of shadowing. With the guided checks they're issuing certificates in their first week.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For solo owner-operators formalizing their first authentication process.
For growing floors that need accountability and dispute-ready evidence.
For multi-location resale groups with volume and compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: SigilVault is authentication infrastructure for independent luxury resale — verified intake, defensible provenance, and certificates that hold up.
